diagnosis.detection_taxonomy: OWASP v2 does not explicitly assign XML parser differentials, signature wrapping, or validation/consumption representation mismatch.
diagnosis.stability: Both cited SHA-1 defaults remain in the post-fix source but were not raised there; the pre/post difference therefore demonstrates context or sampling sensitivity rather than patch specificity.
diagnosis.falsification_accuracy: The SHA-1 rationales establish a weak default but do not establish signature forgery or authentication bypass. They must not become positive training labels without human adjudication.
diagnosis.qualification_usage: The manufactured falsification artifact reported zero usage because qualify-instrument filtered a dedicated run by wrapper stage instead of including calls attributed to falsify. Exact qualification usage is unavailable and is not fabricated.
